cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 2 on-track passes, 1 pit stop, 9 cars that never finished, 1 safety car.

cards.title: 13 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 22 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Bearman and Hamilton gained the most by the end of it, 4 places each
22 cars started on intermediates
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the sprint.

cards.title: 6 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the sprint.
bullets: Lap 1: Perez and Stroll, causing a collision
2 in no further action and 4 left for after the sprint

cards.title: Stroll is out
cards.text: His sprint ends on lap 1 of 20, in an Aston Martin.
bullets: Started P18
Race control logged an incident with Perez and Stroll at Turn 16 on lap 1

cards.title: Sainz starts from the pit lane. Where does he finish?
cards.text: 20 laps to make up ground from there.
cards.reveal: Out of the points. The exact place comes at the flag.

cards.title: Every gap on track, erased
cards.text: The field bunches up behind the safety car, and whatever anybody had built is gone.
bullets: Verstappen was leading when it came out
Neutralised until lap 6
cards.note: This early, nobody had a lead to lose. What it did do was hand a cheap stop to whoever was ready to take one.

cards.title: Russell is out
cards.text: His sprint ends on lap 2 of 20, in a Mercedes.
bullets: Started P2
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Perez is out
cards.text: His sprint ends on lap 2 of 20, in a Cadillac.
bullets: Started P20
Race control logged an incident with Perez and Stroll at Turn 16 on lap 1

cards.title: Hadjar is out
cards.text: His sprint ends on lap 3 of 20, in a Red Bull.
bullets: P10 at the start of lap 2
Started P9

cards.title: Colapinto is out
cards.text: His sprint ends on lap 3 of 20, in an Alpine.
bullets: P12 at the start of lap 2
Started P11

cards.title: Yellow flags out 6 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track
Track sector 13 saw 5 calls, more than anywhere else

cards.title: Track at 40°C at the start, falling to 38°C at the flag
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the sprint.

cards.title: 10 lap times deleted
cards.text: The white line is the track, and the lap simply stops counting if you leave it.
bullets: Hulkenberg and Leclerc lost 2 each, the most of anybody
cards.note: Keep doing it and it turns into a penalty.

cards.title: Bortoleto is out
cards.text: His sprint ends on lap 7 of 20, in an Audi.
bullets: P13 at the start of lap 6
Started P14
Race control logged an incident with Albon and Bortoleto at Turn 16 on lap 6

cards.title: Bottas is out
cards.text: His sprint ends on lap 7 of 20, in a Cadillac.
bullets: P15 at the start of lap 6
Started P21

cards.title: Lap 9: an incident between Gasly and Hulkenberg at Turn 1. What do you give?
cards.text: Race control has flagged it and it lands on your desk. If one driver is to blame, what does he get? Same call the stewards had to make.

outcomes.none: You let it go. Nobody loses a place at a desk, and the driver behind spends the rest of the race on the radio.
outcomes.5: Five seconds gets added at the next stop, or to the final time if there is no stop left. Usually one position, sometimes none.
outcomes.10: Ten seconds is a real punishment and it almost always costs track position, which is why teams argue so hard about it.

cards.reveal: The stewards took no further action.

cards.title: Gasly, Sainz, Lawson and 1 other hit 277 km/h
cards.text: The trap reads one fixed point on the lap, so a car can go faster elsewhere. And the fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Hamilton on lap 20, 1:45.457, in a Ferrari.

cards.title: Verstappen had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: Norris went the other way: 3 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the sprint delivered another.
bullets: P5 on the grid, P8 at the flag
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A sprint asks for 20 of them

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.
cards.reveal: Piastri, on lap 20 of 20. Race control had logged an incident involving Norris and Piastri at Turn 5.

cards.title: Albon is out
cards.text: His sprint ends on lap 15 of 20, in a Williams.
bullets: P15 at the start of lap 14
Started P19

cards.title: Sainz: from the pit lane, P12 at the flag
cards.text: 10 places gained.
bullets: 9 cars that started ahead of him retired

cards.title: How far behind was Hamilton at the flag?
cards.text: 20 laps, about 40 minutes of racing. Put a number on the gap to the winner.

cards.title: 13 of 22 cars never stopped
cards.text: Nobody who finished needed a second set.
bullets: On one set the whole way: intermediates for 13
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane.

cards.title: Piastri is out
cards.text: His sprint ends on lap 20 of 20, in a McLaren.
bullets: P4 at the start of lap 19
Started P4
Race control logged an incident with Norris and Piastri at Turn 5 on lap 20

cards.title: Hamilton: 1:45.457
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all sprint, in a Ferrari.
bullets: Set on lap 20 of 20, late on, where they usually land
By then the fuel is nearly gone and the car is at its lightest
A sprint has never paid a point for it

cards.title: Verstappen wins it
cards.text: P1 Verstappen · P2 Hamilton · P3 Leclerc.
bullets: After 20 laps, Hamilton crossed the line 2.591s behind
